# Waiback

> Waiback is a wayback machine for large language models by Ted Kwartler. Every model is asked the same fixed set of questions and its answers are preserved with a date, so you can see how models answer and how that changes as they are added and updated.

Models: 375 | Questions: 46 | Updated: 2026-10-23

## Data (machine-readable)
- Index of all data: https://waiback.org/api/index.json
- Per-model answers: https://waiback.org/api/models/<slug>.json
- Per-question answers: https://waiback.org/api/questions/<id>.json

## Data
- For researchers (download, API, citation): https://waiback.org/data.html
- JSON index: https://waiback.org/api/index.json
